approved: Industry Research and Development Amendment (Innovation and Science Australia) Bill 2016
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would replace Innovation Australia with a new independent body and create a legal framework for government spending on science and research programs.
The new body, Innovation and Science Australia, would give strategic advice across government, conduct audits, and develop a long-term national plan.
The framework would let the responsible Minister prescribe programs through legislative instruments subject to parliamentary scrutiny.
Transition Innovation Australia to become Innovation and Science Australia.
Insert a statutory framework for Commonwealth spending on industry, innovation, science and research programs.
Allow the responsible Minister to prescribe programs in disallowable legislative instruments.
Authorise a Minister, accountable authority, or delegate to make and administer arrangements for program activities.
Create a Deputy Chair position to be filled by Australia’s Chief Scientist.
Industry, innovation, science and research programs, the Commonwealth, and bodies like Innovation and Science Australia and the responsible Minister.
